backend/main.mo: Main actor for the ICP backend defining product, order, user, and settings types with CRUD operations, access control, Razorpay/Stripe integration, and blob storage mixins.
backend/migration.mo: Data migration module that transforms old orders (with ShippingDetails/GuestDetails) into the new schema using a flat DeliveryInfo structure.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two delivery-details features to their relevant frontend files and test IDs with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated summaries of all frontend source files describing component responsibilities, hook exports, and recent changes to the admin and customer-facing pages.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes including colors, borders, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic storefront, loading Playfair Display/Lato fonts and the Razorpay checkout script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app file configuring TanStack Router with all customer and admin routes, query client, theme provider, and layout wrappers including admin auth guard.
frontend/src/components/AboutAyurveda.ts: A React section component that presents Ayurveda philosophy, the three doshas, and a CTA button to the shop, with slide-in animations triggered by an IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAuthG: A route guard component that verifies the current user has admin privileges via the backend actor before rendering children, redirecting to login or showing an error/denied screen otherwise.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminLayou: Provides the shared admin panel layout with a responsive sidebar (desktop and mobile overlay) containing navigation links, a brand header, and a sign-out button.
frontend/src/components/admin/AIImageGen: A UI component that simulates AI image generation by mapping text prompts to curated Unsplash botanical/nature images, with a prompt input, fake async delay, preview, and a callback to use the selected image.
frontend/src/components/admin/OrderDetai: A modal dialog that displays full order details (customer info, items, payment status) and allows admins to update the fulfillment status via a dropdown with optimistic UI feedback.
frontend/src/components/admin/ProductFor: A modal form for creating or editing products, supporting fields like name, price, category, stock, image (upload or AI-generated), status, and key-value specifications, with create/update mutations.
frontend/src/components/admin/StatusBadg: A small presentational component that renders a styled badge for a given ProductStatus enum value, with configurable size and color-coded styles per status.
frontend/src/components/admin/UserDetail: A modal dialog component that displays detailed information about a user, including their principal ID, email, registration date, and order count.
frontend/src/components/AyurvedicHeroAni: An empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/components/Benefits.tsx: Displays a grid of six brand benefit cards (e.g., Natural, Cruelty-Free, Handcrafted) with staggered fade-in animations using IntersectionObserver.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: A slide-out cart drawer using a Sheet component that lists cart items with quantity controls and a checkout button that navigates to the cart page.
frontend/src/components/DeliveryDetailsM: A dialog modal with a validated form collecting full name, phone number, and delivery address before proceeding to payment.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedProducts: Fetches and displays featured products in a responsive grid with skeleton loading states and a 'View All' button linking to the shop page.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: A fixed floating WhatsApp button that resolves the contact number from the backend (with a fallback), shows a tooltip on hover, and opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with brand info, social links, quick navigation links, product links, and contact details in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Full-screen hero section with a Ken Burns background image, animated entrance effects, CTA buttons to shop or scroll to benefits, and trust badge icons.
Slide-in mobile navigation drawer with nav links, authentication-aware login/logout action, and a backdrop overlay for closing.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Sticky top navigation bar with desktop nav links, cart icon with item count badge, auth-aware login/logout, and a hamburger menu that opens the MobileNavDrawer.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Displays a single product card with image, status badge, add-to-cart and buy-now buttons, and opens a DeliveryDetailsModal before initiating a Razorpay checkout.
frontend/src/components/SeedProducts.tsx: Invisible utility component that seeds the backend with sample products when the product list is empty on mount.
frontend/src/components/Testimonials.tsx: Displays a grid of customer testimonials with intersection-observer-driven fade-in animations and summary trust statistics above the cards.
frontend/src/context/CartContext.tsx: A React context provider for cart state management using BigInt for prices and product IDs, with sessionStorage persistence and helpers for add, remove, update, and clear operations.
frontend/src/contexts/CartContext.tsx: An alternative React cart context provider using string product IDs and numeric prices, with sessionStorage persistence and cart open/close state.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: A custom hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout, and exposing identity and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: A collection of React Query hooks wrapping backend actor calls for CRUD operations on products, orders, users, and site settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpay.ts: Custom React hook that wraps the Razorpay SDK to open a payment checkout modal, handling mobile/desktop UPI flow differences, payment success/failure navigation, and order creation via mutation.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind directives, imports Google Fonts (Playfair Display and Lato), and defines CSS custom properties for the storefront and admin panel color palettes in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and the root App component.
Admin dashboard displaying store KPIs (revenue, orders, products, users) along with bar and pie charts for revenue by month and order fulfillment status breakdown.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLogin.tsx: Admin login page using Internet Identity that checks or claims admin status on the canister, handling states like checking, claiming, denied, and error.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminOrders.tsx: Admin orders management page with sortable, searchable order cards that display delivery info and allow updating fulfillment status via a dropdown.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminProducts.t: Admin page for managing the product catalog with search, stats by status, and CRUD operations (add/edit/delete) via a form modal and confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page for configuring store info, contact email, announcement banner, Razorpay key, and WhatsApp number, with save handlers and loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUsers.tsx: Admin page that lists all registered users in a searchable table and opens a detail modal on row click.
frontend/src/pages/Cart.tsx: Cart page component that displays cart items with quantity controls, collects a shipping address form, validates inputs, and initiates a Razorpay checkout on submission.
frontend/src/pages/Checkout.tsx: Stripe-based checkout page that collects shipping details and creates a Stripe checkout session, redirecting the user to the hosted payment URL.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page that composes the storefront landing sections: Hero, FeaturedProducts, Benefits, Testimonials, AboutAyurveda, and a SeedProducts utility component.
frontend/src/pages/Orders.tsx: Orders page that fetches and displays the authenticated user's order history with product details, delivery info, and payment/fulfillment status badges.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Static payment failure page shown after an unsuccessful transaction, offering buttons to retry checkout or return to the shop.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Displays a payment success confirmation page with a green checkmark, invalidates the orders cache, and provides navigation buttons to view orders or continue shopping.
frontend/src/pages/ProductDetail.tsx: Shows a detailed product page with quantity selection, add-to-cart, and buy-now (Razorpay) functionality, including a delivery details modal before checkout.
frontend/src/pages/Shop.tsx: Renders the shop listing page with search, category, and status filters applied to the product list fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/utils/deviceDetection.ts: Exports isMobileDevice() which detects mobile/tablet devices using user-agent pattern matching and a 768px screen-width fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides formatINR() for Indian Rupee currency formatting and formatDate() for converting nanosecond timestamps to a readable date string.
frontend/src/utils/seedProducts.ts: Exports a sampleProducts array of five ProductInput objects with Ayurvedic product data used for seeding the catalog.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL/hash query parameters, persisting them in sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic frontend, defining dark mode, custom color tokens (Ayurvedic brand palette, admin-specific tokens), fonts, border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations including Ken Burns effect.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file for the Nature Glow Ayurvedic e-commerce app, documenting the current version, known issues, existing features, and pending feature requests centered on adding a customer delivery details form before Razorpay payment and displaying that info in the admin panel.
